    Install Weightline

    iPhone or iPad. In Safari, tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, and turn on Open as Web App if shown.

    Android. In Chrome, open the menu and choose Install app or Install and create shortcut.

    Open Weightline once while online. To bring existing holdings into the installed app, use Portfolio backup at the bottom of the page.

    Portfolio backup

    Download your prices, holdings, and gain/loss inputs. Open the installed app and restore the file to pick up where you left off.
